correctness.rationale: For all m>=1, the true 3m vertices decompose into an orthogonal crosspolytope and simplex in two distinct affine layers. Positive two-orbit weights yield c=(2m+1)^-1 1 and Q=2m times their weighted covariance, with exact diagonal eigenvalues. Both contact identities are algebraically 1; averaging any competing ellipsoid gives tr(B^-1Q)<=2m and AM-GM proves determinant optimality and uniqueness. The exact rational verifier rebuilt vertices and matrices for m=1..15 and passed; the proof, not finite tests, covers all m.

value.rationale: A natural infinite family of branch-graph cosmological polytopes exhibits a fully classified three-mode optimal *outer ellipsoid*, an all-vertex contact set and an exact exponentially small volume ratio to the previously known ball. The nonuniform contact weights and exponential geometric discrepancy are not supplied by the graph-independent circumradius or vertex-uniform inertia result. The star graph is the first branching tree family, and its metric ellipsoid is a motivated complete invariant rather than a random finite slice.
